subject: [PATCH v2 5/5] nfsd: mark the delegation written on COPY/CLONE instead of stamping c/mtime

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFS server to mark a delegation as written when performing a COPY or CLONE operation under a timestamp delegation, rather than stamping the destination's c/mtime with the server's current time. This change allows the holder of the delegation to supply their own c/mtime and avoids potential issues where the client's coarse timestamp may not accurately reflect the server's timestamp. The patch also updates the async COPY thread to mark the delegation as written when the copy has completed writing data, ensuring that the delegation is properly marked even if it was granted while the copy was running.
